statement: 'Adrenal fatigue' is not a real medical condition; there is no scientific basis for the concept and no validated test for it.
effect_size: Systematic review of 58 studies found no substantiation of the concept; diagnostic methods heterogeneous and unvalidated

provenance.primary: Cadegiani FA, Kater CE - 'Adrenal fatigue does not exist: a systematic review', BMC Endocrine Disorders 2016
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: Debunks the cash-clinic 'adrenal fatigue' diagnosis. Distinct from real adrenal insufficiency/Addison's (diagnosable via ACTH stimulation, life-threatening). Levers for chronic-stress symptoms are sleep/stress/exercise/light, not cortisol supplements.

statement: The same neuroendocrine mediators that protect acutely (cortisol, catecholamines, inflammatory cytokines) cause cumulative multi-system damage ('allostatic load') when chronically over- or under-activated.
effect_size: Conceptual/framework; cumulative-burden construct linked to cardiometabolic, immune, and neural aging

provenance.primary: McEwen BS - 'Protective and Damaging Effects of Stress Mediators', New England Journal of Medicine 1998
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: The rigorous version of 'chronic stress damages you'. Bridge from psychosocial stress (Domain M) to endocrine aging. Honest limit: allostatic load is a measured-burden correlate, not a single lever you lower with a product.
dedup_note: Same finding as canonical claim 'allostatic-load-framework' (Allostatic-load framework); retained for chapter coverage, not counted as an independent claim.

statement: Serum total and especially free testosterone decline gradually with age in healthy men (~1%/year from ~30-40), with free testosterone falling faster as SHBG rises.
effect_size: ~1%/year decline; free fraction declines faster than total
population: Healthy men, Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging (BLSA)

provenance.primary: Harman SM, Metter EJ, Tobin JD, Pearson J, Blackman MR - 'Longitudinal Effects of Aging on Serum Total and Free Testosterone Levels in Healthy Men', JCEM 2001
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: A slope, not a cliff (contrast female menopause). Most older men in the biochemically 'low' range are asymptomatic; a low number alone is not a disease. Lifestyle (sleep, fat loss, resistance training) raises endogenous T.

statement: Testosterone replacement in older men with confirmed low testosterone plus symptoms produces modest benefits: real improvement in sexual function/libido, smaller effects on mood and walking, and no meaningful cognitive benefit.
effect_size: Significant improvement in sexual function/libido; null memory/cognition sub-trial; small mood/mobility effects
population: ~790 men aged >=65 with unequivocally low T and symptoms (The Testosterone Trials)

provenance.primary: Snyder PJ, et al. - 'Effects of Testosterone Treatment in Older Men', New England Journal of Medicine 2016
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: Legitimate treatment for confirmed symptomatic hypogonadism; NOT a longevity drug for normal-range T. CV safety addressed by TRAVERSE (Lincoff 2023, section 10). Endocrine Society guideline = Bhasin 2018 (10.1210/jc.2018-00229). Supraphysiologic/aesthetic dosing is a different, worse-risk drug.

statement: DHEA replacement to youthful levels in elderly adults produces no beneficial effect on body composition, physical performance, insulin sensitivity, or quality of life.
effect_size: Null across body composition, physical performance, insulin sensitivity, and QoL despite restored DHEA levels
population: 2-year placebo-controlled RCT, elderly women (DHEA) and men (DHEA or testosterone)

provenance.primary: Nair KS, et al. - 'DHEA in Elderly Women and DHEA or Testosterone in Elderly Men', New England Journal of Medicine 2006
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: The cleanest predictor-not-lever result in the endocrine section: restoring the number did not deliver outcomes. Debunks OTC 'youth hormone' marketing. Narrow legitimate uses exist (documented adrenal insufficiency, some fertility contexts).

statement: Subclinical hypothyroidism is associated with higher coronary heart disease events and mortality mainly at higher TSH levels (>=10 mIU/L), not at the mild elevations most people have.
effect_size: Increased CHD events/mortality concentrated at TSH >=10 mIU/L; little/no signal at mild elevation
population: Individual-participant-data meta-analysis of multiple prospective cohorts

provenance.primary: Rodondi N, et al. - 'Subclinical Hypothyroidism and the Risk of Coronary Heart Disease and Mortality', JAMA 2010
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: Predictor (cohort/meta), not a treatment trial. Pair with TRUST (Stott 2017, section 10) which found levothyroxine for subclinical hypothyroidism in older adults gave NO symptom/QoL benefit (rct-null). Honest practice: treat overt disease; resist medicating a borderline TSH.

statement: Most active thyroid hormone (T3) is generated outside the thyroid by deiodinase enzymes that convert T4 to T3 tissue-by-tissue, providing local control of thyroid hormone action.
effect_size: Tissue-specific deiodinase (D1/D2/D3) control of intracellular T3 availability

provenance.primary: Gereben B, et al. - 'Cellular and Molecular Basis of Deiodinase-Regulated Thyroid Hormone Signaling', Endocrine Reviews 2008
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: Explains why whole-body labs don't capture all thyroid action and why 'free T3 optimization' claims overreach. Mechanism, not an outcome lever.

statement: Ectopic fat accumulation in liver and muscle directly impairs insulin signaling there, making insulin resistance the central, reversible node of cardiometabolic disease.
effect_size: Intracellular lipid intermediates impair insulin signaling in liver/skeletal muscle

provenance.primary: Shulman GI - 'Ectopic Fat in Insulin Resistance, Dyslipidemia, and Cardiometabolic Disease', New England Journal of Medicine 2014
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: Why visceral/ectopic fat (not weight alone) drives insulin resistance, and why emptying those depots reverses it. Cross-ref Domain L (homair-fasting-insulin-predicts-cvd, hba1c) and Domain D. Insulin/IGF-1 signaling = nutrient-sensing aging hallmark (Domain B).

statement: Humans with growth-hormone-receptor deficiency (Laron syndrome, very low IGF-1) show a major reduction in pro-aging signaling, cancer, and diabetes.
effect_size: Near-absence of diabetes and very low cancer incidence in decades-followed Laron cohort vs relatives
population: Ecuadorian Laron-syndrome cohort followed for decades + relatives

provenance.primary: Guevara-Aguirre J, et al. - 'Growth Hormone Receptor Deficiency Is Associated with a Major Reduction in Pro-Aging Signaling, Cancer, and Diabetes in Humans', Science Translational Medicine 2011
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: Human echo of long-lived GH/IGF-1-deficient dwarf mice (Bartke, Domain C) and daf-2 worms (Kenyon, Domain B). Small cohort, rare genotype. Core of the growth-longevity tradeoff: less GH/IGF-1 signaling = less cancer/diabetes (mortality from non-aging causes, e.g. accidents, complicates lifespan readout).
dedup_note: Same finding as canonical claim 'laron-ghr-deficiency-cancer-diabetes-protection' (Laron/GHR-deficiency cancer-diabetes protection); retained for chapter coverage, not counted as an independent claim.

statement: Among people who have already reached exceptional age, lower IGF-1 predicts longer subsequent survival, most notably in women and those with a cancer history.
effect_size: Lower IGF-1 tertile associated with longer survival among nonagenarians/centenarians

provenance.primary: Milman S, et al. - 'Low insulin-like growth factor-1 level predicts survival in humans with exceptional longevity', Aging Cell 2014
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: Tempers 'higher IGF-1 is better'. Apparent tension with the IGF-1 U-shape (Domain L) is resolved by context: very low IGF-1 is also bad (frailty); the longevity-favorable region is NOT 'youthful-high'. IGF-1 is a context-dependent dial, not a minimize- or maximize-target.

statement: Growth hormone in healthy elderly adults produces small body-composition changes (more lean mass, less fat) but no proven functional benefit and a high rate of adverse effects.
effect_size: Small lean-mass gain / fat loss (surrogate); increased edema, arthralgia, carpal tunnel, gynecomastia, glucose intolerance; no functional benefit
population: Systematic review of GH trials in the healthy elderly

provenance.primary: Liu H, et al. - 'Systematic Review: The Safety and Efficacy of Growth Hormone in the Healthy Elderly', Annals of Internal Medicine 2007
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: The systematic-review counterweight to the single 1990 Rudman study (NEJM, 10.1056/NEJM199007053230101) used to sell anti-aging HGH. Body-composition benefit is a surrogate that CONTRADICTS the longevity direction (raising GH/IGF-1). Prescribing GH for anti-aging is illegal in the US. Cross-ref section 10.7.4 (secretagogues).

statement: Recombinant leptin dramatically reverses obesity in rare congenital leptin deficiency, but produces only modest, inconsistent weight loss in common obesity, where people are leptin-resistant (already have high leptin).
effect_size: Dramatic fat loss in congenital deficiency; modest/inconsistent loss in common obesity
population: Congenital leptin-deficient child (Farooqi 1999) vs obese/lean adults RCT (Heymsfield 1999)

provenance.primary: Heymsfield SB, et al. - 'Recombinant Leptin for Weight Loss in Obese and Lean Adults', JAMA 1999
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: Leptin discovery = Zhang 1994 (Nature, 10.1038/372425a0); deficiency rescue = Farooqi 1999 (NEJM, 10.1056/NEJM199909163411204). Common obesity is leptin RESISTANCE (a cousin of insulin resistance), so more leptin doesn't help. The working appetite-drug lever is the gut incretin (GLP-1) axis, not leptin (section 10).

statement: Exogenous melatonin produces a modest, real but small improvement in sleep (shortens sleep onset by roughly a few minutes, slightly increases total sleep and efficiency), best explained as a circadian timing signal rather than a hypnotic.
effect_size: Sleep onset reduced ~7 min; small increases in total sleep time and sleep efficiency
population: Meta-analyses of melatonin RCTs for primary sleep disorders

provenance.primary: Ferracioli-Oda E, Qawasmi A, Bloch MH - 'Meta-Analysis: Melatonin for the Treatment of Primary Sleep Disorders', PLoS ONE 2013
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: Pair with Brzezinski 2004 (Sleep Med Rev, 10.1016/j.smrv.2004.06.004). Strongest for timing problems (jet lag, delayed sleep phase). Low dose (~0.3-1 mg) timed correctly often beats 3-10 mg OTC megadoses. Not a sedative for chronic insomnia (use CBT-I + light timing). Cross-ref Domain I / recovery section.

statement: Vitamin D supplementation (2000 IU/day) in a general, largely non-deficient population does not reduce cancer or cardiovascular events, nor prevent fractures.
effect_size: No significant reduction in invasive cancer or major cardiovascular events over ~5y; no fracture benefit in general population

provenance.primary: Manson JE, et al. - 'Vitamin D Supplements and Prevention of Cancer and Cardiovascular Disease' (VITAL), New England Journal of Medicine 2019
provenance.surfaced_via: Wave-13 endocrine brief; OpenAlex direct-DOI verified

confidence_notes: Vitamin D is a secosteroid HORMONE (nuclear VDR, transcription factor). Correct DOCUMENTED deficiency (real win for bone/elderly); do not mega-dose past repletion chasing non-skeletal outcomes. Low vitamin D in observational data is largely a marker of poor health/obesity/inactivity (reverse causation). Dosing detail in supplements section 03.
dedup_note: Same finding as canonical claim 'vitamin-d-null-in-replete-VITAL' (Vitamin D null in the replete); retained for chapter coverage, not counted as an independent claim.

statement: Most endocrine axes are three-tier negative-feedback loops (hypothalamus -> pituitary -> target gland -> hormone -> feedback up) that defend a set-point; the effector hormone inhibits its own upstream drive.
effect_size: Foundational control architecture (HPA, HPG, HPT axes)

provenance.primary: Standard endocrine physiology (Guyton & Hall; Williams Textbook of Endocrinology) - foundational, not a single primary paper

confidence_notes: The fundamental that grounds the section: read each axis by the stimulating-signal + effector PAIR (locates the lesion); exogenous hormones suppress endogenous production via feedback; and homeostasis is the deep reason 'predictor != lever' (levels are defended outputs, not free knobs). Links to control-theory/feedback in canon 04-information.
